info.title: Svaraa API
info.description:
Svaraa backend API.

**Authentication.** Sign in via `/auth/otp/verify` or `/auth/google` to get an access token, then send
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Use the **Authorize** button above to try protected endpoints.

**Tokens.** The access token lasts 3 days and the refresh token 5 years. Both carry `sub` = `<user_id>:<session_id>`.
When the access token expires, post the refresh token to `/auth/refresh` for a new access token. Logout ends the
session immediately, for both tokens.

**Errors** always have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`; branch on `code`, not `message`.

post.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS
post.description: Sends a one-time code by SMS. Send the country code and the mobile number as separate fields. A number can be asked again only after a 60 second cooldown.

422.description: Validation error (see `fields`), or a precondition such as `profile_name_required`

post.summary: Verify the code and sign in
post.description: Creates the account on first use (only a login record; the profile is created when the user first saves one). Returns the access token, the refresh token, the user id and whether the user is new.

422.description: Validation error (see `fields`), or a precondition such as `profile_name_required`

post.description: Send the ID token from native Google Sign-In. The user can add a mobile number afterwards via `/auth/mobile/*`.

post.summary: Get a new access token
post.description: Send the refresh token. Fails with `session_revoked` after logout and `invalid_token` once the refresh token has expired.

post.summary: End this session
post.description: The session id is blocked immediately, so this token can no longer be used or refreshed.

get.description: One entry per circle you belong to, with your role, its state, the single `next_action` for you, `notices` for the wearer and admins (these replace push in v0), and the setup checklist. Empty until you start setup.

post.description: Call after notification permission is granted, and again whenever the push token changes. A token that belonged to another user is taken over, so it never receives their alerts.

post.summary: Send myself a code to confirm a sensitive action
post.description: Sends an OTP to your own verified mobile number (60 second resend cooldown). Send it back as `otp` on the action: promoting a viewer to admin, approving an admin, demoting or removing an admin, releasing a device, transferring the caretaker or the wearer, or cancelling the circle. Five wrong codes an hour lock further attempts.

post.summary: Start a circle (wearer-first or caretaker-led)
post.description: `wearer_first` (C1): creates the circle, makes you its wearer, and records consent in one step; the circle starts at `pending_pairing`. `caretaker_led` (D1): creates an empty `draft` with you as its admin. A user can be the wearer of one circle only, and an admin/viewer of at most 10.

post.summary: Create or resend the wearer's setup link (D4)
post.description: Admins only. Needs your own profile name, the pendant claimed, the wearer's name and mobile, and at least one emergency contact. Any earlier open link is revoked and the circle moves to `pending_consent` for 14 days. The URL carries only a random token, expires in 72 hours and works only for the wearer's number. It is returned once.

post.summary: Give consent (wearer only)
post.description: Re-consent after a withdrawal. Moves `pending_consent` to `pending_pairing`, and on to `active` once a verified device and a contact exist. Repeating it is harmless. `409 consent_version_outdated` means the app shows old text.

post.summary: Claim a pendant with the code from its box
post.description: Reserves the pendant for the circle (`claimed_unverified`); it is verified later, when the wearer pairs it. Caller must be the circle's wearer or an admin. Scanning again from the same circle is harmless. `409 device_already_claimed` means another circle holds it (screen E5): use `/devices/disputes` if it is yours. Up to 5 pendants per circle. **Mock codes:** in development and staging (never production) any code starting with `MOCK`, e.g. `MOCK-1`, creates a keyless mock pendant on the spot and claims it; each distinct code is a different pendant, and claiming the same one from another circle answers `device_already_claimed`. Pairing it verifies as `press_only`.

post.summary: Start pairing: get a challenge for the pendant to sign

post.summary: Finish pairing: verify the pendant
post.description: Send the pendant's signature of the challenge. On success the device is `claimed_verified` and the circle becomes `active` if consent and a contact exist. Units without a key are verified as `press_only`.

patch.description: Between admin and viewer. Promoting a viewer to admin and demoting an admin both need your OTP (`otp`). The wearer's role is fixed, and you cannot change your own.

post.summary: Remove a member, or leave the circle yourself
post.description: The wearer can remove anyone except themselves. An admin can remove viewers and other admins. Nobody can remove the wearer, and the wearer cannot leave (transfer the pendant or cancel the circle). Removing an admin needs your OTP (`otp`). To leave, send your own user id; leaving needs no OTP.

404.description: Not found, or you are not a member: `circle_not_found`

post.summary: Join a circle with an invite code
post.description: Puts you in the circle's waiting list as `pending_approval`. Strict limits: 5 attempts per hour per user and 20 per IP, right or wrong. You can be an admin or viewer of at most 10 circles.

post.summary: Hand over a caretaker seat (wearer or admin)
post.description: An admin hands over their own seat; the wearer can replace any admin by naming them in `from_user_id`. The receiver must already be an active viewer and has 24 hours to accept (`POST /transfers/{id}/accept`). Needs your OTP. On acceptance the receiver becomes admin and the old admin leaves (or stays as a viewer with `keep_as_viewer`).

404.description: Not found, or you are not a member: `circle_not_found`

post.summary: Hand the pendant to a different wearer (wearer or admin)
post.description: Creates a setup link bound to the new wearer's number; they review, edit and consent through `/setup-invites/*`. Nothing changes until they consent, so the current wearer stays protected meanwhile, and can cancel with `POST /transfers/{id}/cancel`. At consent the old wearer leaves, the new wearer joins, and the pendant goes back to unverified to be paired on the new wearer's phone. Needs your OTP.

404.description: Not found, or you are not a member: `circle_not_found`

post.summary: Cancel the circle (wearer, or an admin before a wearer has joined)
post.description: Ends the circle for good: everyone leaves, open links, codes and handovers stop working, a running drill is cancelled and the pendants are released (their old box tokens are invalidated, so support issues new ones). Needs your OTP.

404.description: Not found, or you are not a member: `circle_not_found`

post.summary: Accept a caretaker seat
post.description: You become an admin. (A wearer handover is accepted by consenting through its setup link instead.)

404.description: Not found, or you are not a member: `circle_not_found`

410.description: The link is no longer usable: `invite_expired`, `invite_revoked`, `invite_used`

post.description: The person who started it can withdraw it. The circle's wearer can cancel any pending transfer, including one an admin started (a veto). A wearer handover's setup link stops working with it.

to_user_id.title: To User Id
